verdict.rationale: The evidence shows models load from the command line (`llama cli -hf ...`, `llama serve -hf ...`), and llama.cpp supports CPU+GPU hybrid inference with partial offload. Community reports confirm GPU layer counts (N_GPU_LAYERS) and GPU/CPU model splitting can be configured, though the N_GPU_LAYERS report came via Python wrappers rather than the CLI itself. Missing for 10: documented CLI flags for GPU layer offload, any evidence of a context-length setting, and hands-on CLI usage of these options.
